Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that polls a transcription job and returns the transcript using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import requests
import json
import time

def poll_and_get_transcript(job_id: str, api_key: str) -> str:
    """
    Polls an AssemblyAI transcription job until completion and returns the transcript text.
    """
    base_url = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"
    headers = {
        "Authorization": api_key,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    while True:
        response = requests.get(f"{base_url}/transcript/{job_id}", headers=headers)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"API request failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")
        data = response.json()
        status = data["status"]
        if status == "completed":
            return data["text"]
        elif status == "error":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Transcription error: {data.get('error', 'Unknown error')}")
        elif status in ["completed_with_errors", "failed"]:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Job completed with errors: {data.get('error', 'Unknown error')}")
        time.sleep(10)
```
